title: ReplaySSM: Cache SSM Inputs, Not State
abstract: State-space models (SSMs) maintain a fixed-size recurrent state, but reading and writing it at every decoding step can bottleneck hybrid models. This eager state management causes large state I/O with low arithmetic intensity, leaves speculative decoding no cheap rollback, and feeds state quantization error into subsequent recurrent updates. We introduce ReplaySSM, which unrolls the recurrence to represent the state as a checkpoint and a buffer of recent SSM inputs. This separates output computation from checkpoint updates. By updating the checkpoint periodically, ReplaySSM avoids state writes on most steps and roughly halves the dominant state memory traffic. Keeping recent inputs also makes speculative rollback a buffer-pointer operation and enables output-only verification without materializing intermediate states. The same separation allows a low-precision checkpoint to serve output computation on most steps while a higher-precision checkpoint serves recurrent updates, so rounding error in the low-precision copy never enters later updates. We implement ReplaySSM in vLLM for Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet. At serving batch size 256, it accelerates standard decoding by $1.20$--$1.47\times$ over a tuned vLLM baseline across four hybrid models, and delivers about $1.8\times$ the throughput of vLLM's speculative decoding on the two 120B-class models. Separate state precisions also reduce output KL divergence and downstream accuracy losses compared with a shared low-precision checkpoint.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In our graduate course on Efficient Language Model Inference, today’s lecture is on Replay S-S-M: Cache S-S-M Inputs, Not State. Recent work such as Sketch S-S-M and Quamba Two reflects growing interest in making recurrent models faster and more practical to serve. This paper, by researchers at Princeton and NVIDIA, asks whether an S-S-M needs to write its entire recurrent state after every token. That matters as hybrid models combine attention with recurrent components. Yes, Noah, go ahead.
segments.zh: 在我们这门关于高效语言模型推理的研究生课上，今天讲的是Replay S-S-M：缓存S-S-M的输入，而不是状态。最近像Sketch S-S-M和Quamba Two这样的工作，反映出大家越来越关注怎么让循环模型跑得更快、更适合实际部署。这篇论文来自普林斯顿和NVIDIA的研究人员，它问的是：S-S-M是不是每处理一个token都得把整个循环状态写一遍？这个问题很关键，因为现在混合模型会把注意力和循环组件结合起来用。好，Noah，你说。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, if an S-S-M state stays fixed in size, why is decoding still expensive?
segments.zh: 教授您好，如果S-S-M的状态大小是固定的，那为什么解码还是很贵呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Fixed size avoids the growing K-V cache that attention needs, but it does not make state access free. Conventional decoding reads and writes the full recurrent state at every token, even when the update performs relatively little computation. At large batch sizes, that traffic can become a bottleneck. Replay S-S-M targets this cost by changing how the state is represented between updates, rather than trying to make each conventional update slightly faster.
segments.zh: 固定大小避免了注意力机制所需的不断增长的K-V缓存，但这并不意味着状态访问就是免费的。传统解码在每个token上都要读写完整的循环状态，即使更新本身的计算量相对很小。在大批量场景下，这种读写流量会成为瓶颈。Replay S-S-M针对的正是这一开销，它的做法是改变更新之间状态的表示方式，而不是试图让每次传统更新稍微快一点。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The central idea is to keep a checkpoint for the state at the end of a completed window, alongside a bounded buffer of recent token inputs. To produce an output, the system combines the checkpoint with the buffered inputs; it does not immediately save a new full state. When the buffer fills, a flush folds those inputs into the checkpoint. Think of the checkpoint as a bookmark and the buffer as the short stretch of reading since you last marked your place.
segments.zh: 核心思路是，在一个窗口结束时给状态留一个检查点，同时保留一个容量有限的近期token输入缓冲区。要生成输出时，系统把检查点和缓冲区里的输入结合起来，而不是立刻保存一份新的完整状态。当缓冲区满了，一次刷新会把这些输入折叠进检查点。可以把检查点想成书签，把缓冲区想成你上次标记位置之后读的那一小段。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: does the method avoid reading the checkpoint too, or just avoid writing it each time?
segments.zh: 问个快问题：这个方法是不是连读取检查点也省了，还是只是不用每次都写？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: It still reads the checkpoint at each step, because the output depends on it. The key saving is fewer full-state writes: with a window of 16 steps, the system writes one updated checkpoint for that window instead of writing a full state at every step. The buffer records are smaller than the state, but processing them takes extra work. So the window length is a trade-off, not a free reduction in cost.
segments.zh: 它每一步仍然会读取检查点，因为输出依赖于它。关键的节省在于减少了完整状态的写入次数：当窗口为16步时，系统只为这个窗口写一次更新后的检查点，而不是每一步都写一次完整状态。缓冲区记录比状态本身小，但处理它们需要额外的工作。所以窗口长度是一种权衡，并不是无代价的成本降低。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How does that representation help when speculative decoding rejects some proposed tokens?
segments.zh: 这种表示方式在推测解码拒绝掉一些候选token时能起到什么作用？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: A conventional S-S-M has already compressed its token history into the current state, so rolling back can require saved state snapshots or recomputation. Replay S-S-M instead appends draft-token inputs to its buffer while calculating their outputs. Once verification identifies the accepted prefix, the system advances a buffer pointer to commit it. Rejected records fall outside that prefix and can be overwritten, much like discarding pages from a temporary working stack.
segments.zh: 传统的S-S-M已经把token历史压缩进了当前状态，所以回滚时可能需要依赖保存的状态快照或重新计算。而Replay S-S-M则是在计算草稿token输出的同时，把它们的输入追加到缓冲区里。一旦验证确定了被接受的prefix，系统就移动缓冲区指针来提交它。被拒绝的记录落在这个prefix之外，可以直接覆盖，就像从临时工作栈里丢弃几页一样。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The verification calculation is also arranged to avoid constructing an intermediate full state for every draft token. It combines queries and keys first, then uses those results to weight and sum the value vectors. Gated DeltaNet requires extra care because its corrections depend on preceding states; Replay S-S-M solves a small triangular system to obtain those corrections. For both model families, the goal is to calculate the needed outputs without materializing a sequence of full recurrent states.
segments.zh: 验证计算也做了安排，避免为每个草稿token都构建一个完整的中间状态。它先把查询和键组合起来，再用这些结果对值向量做加权求和。Gated DeltaNet需要额外小心，因为它的修正依赖于之前的状态；Replay S-S-M通过求解一个小型三角系统来得到这些修正。对这两个模型家族来说，目标都是在不实际生成一连串完整循环状态的情况下，算出所需的输出。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: A third contribution separates the precision used for output calculations from the precision used to continue the recurrence. Replay S-S-M can keep a high-precision checkpoint for updates and a lower-precision copy for output reads. At a flush, it updates from the high-precision checkpoint and independently stores the new checkpoint in both formats. That prevents rounding in the low-precision copy from being repeatedly fed back into the recurrent path, though individual outputs can still be approximate.
segments.zh: 第三项贡献是把输出计算所用的精度和继续做循环所用的精度分开。Replay S-S-M 可以保留一份高精度检查点用于更新，再留一份低精度副本用于读取输出。在刷新时，它从高精度检查点进行更新，并分别以两种格式存储新的检查点。这样就能避免低精度副本里的舍入误差被反复喂回循环路径，尽管单个输出仍然可能是近似的。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Can you connect those design choices to what was actually tested?
segments.zh: 你能把这些设计选择和实际测试的内容联系起来吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The authors implemented the method in v-L-L-M for Mamba Two and G-D-N, and compared it with a tuned conventional baseline using CUDA graphs. Their four hybrid models ran on single H100 or B300 G-P-Us. With a window of 16 and batch size 256, isolated S-S-M kernels improved by 1.46 to 1.80 times, while whole-model decoding improved by 1.20 to 1.47 times. The smaller whole-model gain is expected because attention and other components remain unchanged.
segments.zh: 作者在v-L-L-M中为Mamba Two和G-D-N实现了该方法，并与使用CUDA图的调优传统基线进行了比较。他们的四个混合模型在单块H100或B300 G-P-U上运行。在窗口为16、批大小为256的情况下，孤立的S-S-M内核提升了1.46到1.80倍，而整模型解码提升了1.20到1.47倍。整模型提升较小是意料之中的，因为注意力和其他组件保持不变。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So are the gains consistent across batch sizes and context lengths?
segments.zh: 那这些提升在不同批量大小和上下文长度下都一致吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: No. At batch size one, the isolated kernel is at or below parity, because conventional state updates are not saturating memory bandwidth. The gains grow at larger batches, where state traffic matters more. They are also largest at shorter and medium contexts; as context grows, attention’s K-V traffic takes a larger share of runtime. This is why the authors’ results should be read as evidence for particular serving conditions, not as a universal speedup for every S-S-M workload.
segments.zh: 不是。在批大小为1时，单独的内核基本持平甚至略低，因为传统状态更新还没有把内存带宽打满。批越大，收益越明显，因为这时状态流量更关键。收益在短上下文和中等上下文时也最大；上下文越长，注意力的K-V流量在运行时间中占比越高。所以作者的结果应该被理解为特定服务条件下的证据，而不是对所有S-S-M工作负载的普遍加速。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The speculative results show the value of avoiding snapshots when concurrency is high. At batch size 512 and verification length 4, throughput reaches 1.85 times the conventional speculative baseline on Nemotron Three Super and 2.10 times on Quen three point five 122B. Acceptance lengths are closely matched, so the difference is not explained by accepting more draft tokens. For low precision, the authors also report substantially reduced long-generation output-distribution error when recurrence remains higher precision.
segments.zh: 推测解码的结果表明，高并发时避免快照是值得的。在批大小为512、验证长度为4时，吞吐量达到传统推测基线的1.85倍（Nemotron Three Super）和2.10倍（Quen 3.5 122B）。接受长度非常接近，所以差异并不是因为接受了更多草稿token。在低精度方面，作者还报告说，当递归部分保持更高精度时，长生成输出分布误差大幅降低。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: What is the main limitation we should keep in mind when comparing this with related work?
segments.zh: 和相关工作比较时，我们最该记住的主要局限是什么？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Replay S-S-M complements work such as Sketch S-S-M, which reduces repeated state reads using a compact sketch, while Replay S-S-M primarily reduces checkpoint writes and enables rollback without snapshots. Quamba Two provides context for state quantization, but Replay S-S-M’s separate precision paths address a different issue: preventing low-precision output copies from driving later recurrent updates. The paper’s evidence is bounded to four models and single-G-P-U tests, and the method still reads the checkpoint at every step.
segments.zh: Replay S-S-M 与 Sketch S-S-M 这类工作形成互补，后者用紧凑的 sketch 减少重复的状态读取，而 Replay S-S-M 主要减少检查点写入，并支持无需快照的回滚。Quamba Two 为状态量化提供了背景，但 Replay S-S-M 的独立精度路径解决的是另一个问题：防止低精度输出副本驱动后续的循环更新。论文的证据仅限于四个模型和单 GPU 测试，而且该方法在每一步仍然要读取检查点。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Could replay-buffer processing or lower-precision outputs still cause problems in practice?
segments.zh: 回放缓冲区的处理或更低精度的输出，在实际中是否仍会带来问题？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Yes. Buffer replay adds computation and storage, and choosing a window means balancing that work against fewer checkpoint writes. Low-precision output reads can still change individual outputs, even if their rounding error is kept out of the recurrent update path. The paper’s accuracy results improve substantially with separate precision, but they are not identical to F-P32 on every model and task. Future work could reduce checkpoint reads as well, but that is not achieved here.
segments.zh: 是的。缓冲回放会增加计算和存储开销，而选择窗口大小意味着要在这部分开销与更少的检查点写入之间做权衡。低精度输出读取仍可能改变个别输出，即使其舍入误差被排除在循环更新路径之外。论文的精度结果在采用分离精度后大幅提升，但在每个模型和任务上并不都与F-P32完全一致。未来工作或许还能减少检查点读取，但本文并未实现这一点。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The broader lesson is that serving efficiency depends not only on the model’s recurrence, but also on how a system represents and commits its state. Replay S-S-M turns recent inputs into a temporary history that can support output computation, delayed updates, and rollback. Its benefits are clearest when state traffic and speculative snapshots constrain large-batch serving. The memorable takeaway is simple: for recurrent decoding, sometimes it is cheaper to replay a short input history than to rewrite the whole state. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 更广泛的启示是，服务效率不仅取决于模型的循环结构，还取决于系统如何表示和提交状态。Replay S-S-M 把近期输入变成一段临时历史，用来支持输出计算、延迟更新和回滚。当状态流量和推测性快照限制了大批量服务时，它的优势最明显。最值得记住的一点很简单：对于循环解码，有时重放一小段输入历史比重写整个状态更便宜。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以问我们的 AI 助手，或者留言评论。
